name: aops-pkb
description: AcademicOps task/work-unit module — the judgment layer at the entry (dispatch-readiness) and exit (acceptance) chokepoints: capture, strategic planning, task-lifecycle, dispatch, and the four-agent sign-off review

pkb_mcp_url.title: PKB MCP server URL
pkb_mcp_url.description: URL of your academicOps PKB MCP server (Streamable HTTP), e.g. http://host:8026/mcp/. Supplied to the pkb MCP server as PKB_MCP_URL. Leave blank only if PKB_MCP_URL is already exported in the environment that launches the MCP server; there is no ~/.env.local fallback.
